description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewer entity class in the OrangeHRM project. It models the reviewer for performance tracking, including properties such as reviewer info, associated performance tracker, and added date, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the performance tracking system, with relationships to performance tracker and employee, and containing metadata such as added date and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity who is the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Assigns an Employee entity as the reviewer.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Returns the PerformanceTracker associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker with this reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date this reviewer was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date this reviewer was added.
